title: Addition formula for two families of orthogonal polynomials in several variables
summary: An addition formula is a closed-form formula for reproducing kernels of orthogonal polynomials of several variables; the latter are kernels of orthogonal projection operators. We derive addition formulas for two families of orthogonal polynomials, which consist of wrapped products of classical Gegenbauer polynomials on the unit ball with either classical Jacobi polynomials on the simplex or product Laguerre polynomials, each of which is given explicitly as a multilayer of integrals of a classical orthogonal polynomial of one variable.
